items.title: RouterOS SSH未认证会话执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证客户端利用SSH rekey后状态缺陷打开会话并发送exec，可能执行命令。
items.repro_note: 未认证SSH客户端在rekey后开通道并发送exec请求
items.impact_scope: 网络设备，SSH管理面常暴露
items.description: RouterOS SSH enters the connection protocol after a client-requested rekey even though user authentication was never attempted, allowing an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request.

items.title: WordPress未授权模板包含RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者触发模板解析包含主题目录外本地PHP文件，在条件满足时导致RCE。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.repro_note: 未授权请求触发get_page_template解析，需服务器与主题条件满足
items.impact_scope: WordPress站点，广泛部署
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker can make `get_page_template()` page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories. If relevant pre-conditions for both the server and the active theme are met, this can lead to RCE.

items.title: NetScaler未认证命令执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用输入校验缺陷向NetScaler ADC/Gateway发送恶意请求，可执行任意命令。
items.repro_note: 未认证访问ADC/Gateway接口，构造畸形输入触发命令执行
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Improper input validation vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: Adobe Commerce授权错误提权
items.summary_zh: 攻击者无需用户交互，利用授权错误提权，访问敏感资源并可能接管账户。
items.action_zh: 升级Commerce到2.4.4、B2B到1.3.3及以上
items.repro_note: 利用授权校验错误构造请求，提升权限并访问敏感资源；需可访问接口
items.impact_scope: 电商CMS，承载交易与账户数据
items.description: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction.

items.title: WSO2 API控制面JWT认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造不支持算法的JWT绕过签名校验，未授权访问控制面并可能接管管理员账户。
items.repro_note: 构造alg为不支持算法的JWT访问API控制面，绕过签名校验
items.impact_scope: API管理中间件，横向移动跳板
items.description: This allows an attacker to craft a JWT with an unsupported algorithm, which is then incorrectly validated, leading to unauthorized access. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may result in unauthorized access to the system, including the potential compromise of administrative accounts and full account takeover.

items.title: NetScaler内存破坏RCE/DoS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用NetScaler ADC/Gateway内存破坏缺陷，可能导致远程代码执行或服务拒绝。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.repro_note: 向ADC/Gateway相关服务发送恶意请求触发内存破坏，观察RCE或崩溃
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，风险影响大
items.description: Vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to Remote Code Execution or Denial of Service

items.title: SharePoint代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已授权攻击者通过网络向SharePoint注入代码，可在服务器执行任意代码。
items.repro_note: 需有效账户，通过SharePoint接口提交恶意内容触发代码注入
items.impact_scope: 企业协作平台，内网横向目标
items.description: Improper control of generation of code ('code injection') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: iOS/iPadOS越界写入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者诱使用户处理恶意构造文件，触发越界写入，可能导致任意代码执行。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至26.7.1及以上
items.repro_note: 需诱导用户打开恶意文件，触发越界写入实现代码执行
items.impact_scope: 移动终端，影响iPhone/iPad
items.description: An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.1 and iPadOS 26.7.1, macOS Sequoia 15.8.1, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1. Processing a maliciously crafted file may lead to arbitrary code execution. Apple is aware of a report that this issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 27.

items.title: GitLab MR diff XSS漏洞
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户通过MR diff路径组件注入恶意脚本，在另一用户浏览器上下文执行JS。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.repro_note: 认证用户构造恶意MR diff路径组件，诱导受害者查看触发XSS
items.impact_scope: 代码托管平台，可窃取会话
items.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.11 before 19.2.7, 19.3 before 19.3.3, and 19.4 before 19.4.1 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of another user's browser session due to improper sanitization of path components in the merge request diff viewer.

items.title: 未知组件堆越界写漏洞
items.title_zh: 未知组件堆越界写漏洞
items.summary_zh: 远程对端可触发服务端堆越界读，特定情况下造成固定值越界写与内存破坏。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商公告，升级至已修复版本（版本未知）
items.repro_note: 远程对端发送特制报文触发堆越界读写，需协议交互
items.impact_scope: 未知服务端组件，远程内存破坏
items.description: Impact summary: A remote peer may be able to cause a small out-of-bounds read, and in some circumstances a fixed-value out-of-bounds write, on the server heap. CWE: CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write Description: A TLS connection records how many certificate slots it has when it is created, taken from the SSL_CTX that created it: the built-in certificate types plus one slot for each provider TLS-SIGALG entry that context was aware of.

items.title: 未知TLS组件UAF拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证对端在特定并发下触发TLS证书链UAF，导致多线程客户端/服务端崩溃。
items.action_zh: 升级使用该TLS组件的产品至已修复版本
items.repro_note: 多线程TLS端并发构建同CA证书链触发UAF，可致进程崩溃
items.impact_scope: TLS组件，远程拒绝服务
items.description: Impact summary: A remote, unauthenticated peer could crash a multi-threaded TLS client, or a multi-threaded TLS server that requests client certificates, if the first certificate chains built to the same trusted CA certificate are built by several connections at the same time. This is a use-after-free read, which is likely to crash the process, resulting in a Denial of Service.

items.title: 未知QUIC组件资源耗尽DoS
items.summary_zh: 恶意远程对端持续发送NEW_CONNECTION_ID帧绕过上限，耗尽本地QUIC栈资源。
items.action_zh: 升级使用该QUIC栈的产品至已修复版本
items.repro_note: 向QUIC栈持续发送NEW_CONNECTION_ID帧，触发资源耗尽
items.impact_scope: QUIC服务端，拒绝服务风险
items.description: Issue summary: A malicious remote peer may flood the local QUIC stack with NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames by avoiding a limit check on how many connection IDs the remote QUIC stack can use. Impact summary: The local QUIC stack sends a RETIRE_CONN_ID frame for every NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame it receives.

items.title: Handlebars.java目录遍历
items.summary_zh: 在特定Spring MVC配置下，攻击者用%2e%2e/绕过校验读取模板目录外文件。
items.action_zh: 升级至4.5.5及以上，避免请求派生视图名
items.repro_note: Spring MVC配置file:前缀且视图名来自请求，用%2e%2e/遍历
items.impact_scope: Java模板组件，敏感文件读取
items.description: Handlebars.java before 4.5.5 allows directory traversal. In a Spring MVC application with a file: template prefix and a request-derived view name, a percent-encoded traversal such as %2e%2e/ bypasses both the view-resolver check and the loader-side containment and reads files outside the configured template base directory.

items.title: HPE Instant ON 未认证代码执行
items.title_zh: HPE Instant ON 未认证代码执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者向受影响接口发送畸形报文触发缓冲区溢出，可以特权用户身份执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级 HPE Instant ON 固件，并将管理接口限制在可信网段
items.repro_note: 向受影响网络接口发送畸形报文，需 HPE Instant ON 设备
items.impact_scope: 无线AP等网络设备，内网高价值
items.description: Buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the affected interface of HPE Networking Instant ON that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to run arbitrary code on the underlying host. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code as a privileged user on the underlying operating system.

items.title: HPE Instant ON 格式串RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者利用格式串缺陷向受影响接口发送载荷，可执行任意命令，导致DoS或接管设备。
items.action_zh: 升级 HPE Instant ON AP 固件，限制管理网段访问
items.repro_note: 构造格式串载荷发送至受影响接口，需设备实测
items.impact_scope: 无线AP，可致内网横向与DoS
items.description: Uncontrolled Format string vulnerabilities exist in the affected interface of HPE Networking Instant ON APs that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the underlying host. Successful exploitation could result in a Denial-of-service or potential remote code execution.

items.title: LightLLM 缓存服务反序列化RCE
items.title_zh: LightLLM 缓存服务反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 多模态部署下缓存服务未授权暴露，攻击者发送恶意序列化对象即可在推理节点执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 关闭或限制缓存服务端口访问，升级至修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权连接缓存服务 RPyC 端口发送 pickle 对象
items.impact_scope: 多模态推理服务节点，端口对外
items.description: LightLLM through 1.2.0 multimodal deployments expose an unauthenticated RPyC cache service with pickle deserialization enabled on all interfaces. Attackers can send crafted serialized objects to exposed cache methods to execute arbitrary code with service privileges.

items.title: Buffer Critical
items.description: Buffer overflow vulnerabilities exist in the affected interface of HPE Networking Instant ON APS that could allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to achieve remote code execution. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

items.title: CLI Critical
items.description: A command injection vulnerability exists in CLI of the affected HPE Networking Instant ON APs that could allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to perform command injection by sending specially crafted packets. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands as a privileged user on the underlying operating system.

items.title: HPE Networking Instant ON Critical
items.description: A vulnerability has been identified in a management protocol of HPE Networking Instant ON APs that could allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls. Successful exploitation could result in a complete bypass of security restrictions, potentially leading to remote code execution with elevated privileges.

items.title: CRLF 未授权 CRLF注入
items.description: Improper neutralization of CRLF sequences in IMAP command construction in psyb0t/docker-mailbox before 0.4.13 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker, when bearer-token authentication is not configured, to inject additional IMAP commands into an authenticated upstream mailbox connection via crafted folder, UID, or search values.

items.title: Hitachi Energy RTU500 未授权 路径遍历
items.description: A directory traversal vulnerability in the file upload functionality of Hitachi Energy RTU500 end-of-life versions allows an unauthenticated attacker to write or overwrite arbitrary files on the device file system. Depending on the files affected, successful exploitation could result in unauthorized modification of device data or disruption of the device’s intended operation.

items.title: @xhmikosr/decompress 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: ### Impact When extracting an untrusted archive with the default `decompress(input, output)` API, a crafted archive containing a chain of symlink entries can make a later entry resolve **outside** the output directory. The lexical containment checks pass, but the kernel follows the planted symlinks to a path outside `output`, letting an attacker write (and read) files outside the intended extraction directory.

items.title: Hitachi Energy RTU500 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability in the firmware update endpoint of Hitachi Energy RTU500 end-of-life versions allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary firmware through a crafted POST request. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to modify device functionality or compromise the integrity or availability of the device.

items.title: PyJWT 签名校验错误
items.description: **Prerequisites** (both conditions must hold; both are deployment properties, not attacker-controlled at request time): - The `jwt.decode` allow-list mixes an HMAC algorithm with an asymmetric one, e.g. The asymmetric-key rejection in `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` is skipped, the public key becomes the HMAC secret, and an attacker who knows the public key mints a valid `HS256` token — universal forgery — whenever the verify allow-list mixes an HMAC and an asymmetric algorithm.

items.title: NetX Duo WebSocket越界写
items.summary_zh: 恶意WebSocket服务端向NetX Duo客户端发送分片帧，利用掩码键造成越界写。
items.action_zh: 升级NetX Duo至已修复版本，避免连接不可信服务端
items.repro_note: 恶意WebSocket服务端发送分片帧，利用掩码键控制越界写
items.impact_scope: 嵌入式安全设备，客户端内存破坏
items.description: NetX Duo's WebSocket client resets the unmasking cursor to the first `NX_PACKET` each time it advances through a chained packet, while the loop's upper bound belongs to the current packet. The four-byte WebSocket masking key controls the bytes written, so the corruption is attacker-chosen rather than incidental.

items.title: 未知安全设备命令注入RCE
items.title_zh: 未知安全设备命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户向文件路径/脚本参数注入单引号，在受管端点以SYSTEM/root执行命令。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至已修复版本，限制管理账户与脚本参数白名单
items.repro_note: 认证用户向路径/脚本参数注入单引号执行命令
items.impact_scope: 终端管理安全设备，控制被管端点
items.description: AiSOC versions 7.2.0 before 12.0.0 contain a command injection vulnerability in the actions service that builds CrowdStrike Real Time Response command strings by interpolating unescaped action parameters in crowdstrike_rtr.py and endpoint.py. Authenticated users can inject single quotes into file_path, path, script_name, or script_args parameters to break out of quoted arguments and execute arbitrary commands on managed endpoints with SYSTEM or root privileges.

items.title: Dockhand Webhook认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用空webhook secret校验缺陷访问git webhook端点，触发任意栈重部署。
items.action_zh: 升级至1.0.40及以上
items.repro_note: 未授权访问git webhook端点，利用空secret绕过校验触发重部署
items.impact_scope: DevOps部署工具，可能影响业务栈
items.description: Dockhand before 1.0.40 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its git webhook endpoints that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger arbitrary stack redeployments by exploiting a null webhook secret guard condition.

items.title: Viidure Android硬编码凭据
items.summary_zh: 攻击者反编译应用获取明文云存储凭据，可读改删固件和应用二进制等文件。
items.action_zh: 更换并轮换云存储凭据，移除硬编码
items.repro_note: 反编译Viidure APK提取硬编码云存储凭据，直接访问存储
items.impact_scope: 移动应用后端存储，数据篡改/删除
items.description: The Viidure Android application embeds permanent, plaintext cloud storage credentials within its compiled code. These credentials provide full access to critical platform storage, including the ability to read, modify, or delete operational files such as firmware and application binaries.

items.title: 未知组件文件导出未授权访问
items.title_zh: 未知组件文件导出未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向文件导出端点发送特制POST，导出任意数据库表，导致数据泄露。
items.action_zh: 限制导出端点认证与表白名单，升级至修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权向文件导出端点发送特制POST，指定表名导出任意表
items.impact_scope: 未知Web服务，数据库敏感信息泄露
items.description: The file export endpoint allows any unauthenticated attacker to export arbitrary database tables by sending a crafted POST request.

items.title: GEOVIA代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager服务端注入代码，可在服务器执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至Dassault已修复版本并限制服务暴露
items.repro_note: 向GEOVIA服务端构造恶意输入触发代码注入，获取服务器执行
items.impact_scope: 工业地理数据服务，服务器失陷
items.description: A Code Injection vulnerability affecting GEOVIA Geospatial Data Manager from Release 3DEXPERIENCE R2024x through Release 3DEXPERIENCE R2026x could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server.

items.title: Fumeng Cloud SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者向AjaxMethod.ashx的Name参数注入SQL，窃取或篡改数据库。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，临时下线或加WAF校验
items.repro_note: 未授权请求getEmpByname动作，Name参数注入SQL
items.impact_scope: 云办公/OA系统，数据库泄露
items.description: Fumasoft Fumeng Cloud contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the AjaxMethod.ashx endpoint that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL through the Name parameter of the getEmpByname action without any authentication. Attackers can exploit UNION-based SQL injection techniques against the Microsoft SQL Server backend to extract, disclose, and modify database contents, with potential for further compromise of the underlying server.

items.title: ogx-ai 提示注入致服务端RCE
items.title_zh: ogx-ai 提示注入致服务端RCE
items.summary_zh: 可影响提示输入的远程攻击者借Jinja2模板语法注入，触发服务端表达式求值，以服务权限执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本，过滤提示并禁用不可信模板渲染，隔离AI服务权限
items.repro_note: 提示输入处注入 {{7*7}} 类Jinja2表达式验证服务端求值
items.impact_scope: AI应用后端服务，权限较高
items.description: Open GenAI Stack (aka ogx-ai) 2026-06-11, as used in the Meta AI backend for WhatsApp and other products, allows code execution because prompt injection (with Jinja2 template syntax) can be used to achieve server-side expression evaluation without sanitization.

items.title: Anjvision 固件ONVIF未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可访问暴露的ONVIF管理端点，无需凭据执行敏感设备管理操作，如改配置、重置设备。
cwe_labels: 初始化不安全(默认凭据)
items.action_zh: 收敛ONVIF管理接口暴露面，升级固件并强制启用认证
items.repro_note: 未授权访问ONVIF device/service管理端点即可提交设备操作
items.impact_scope: RTMP/监控固件设备，常暴露于网络
items.description: In Anjvision YSSD‑RTMP‑H5 firmware version 3.3.2.4, several ONVIF service endpoints process management requests without enforcing required authentication. This could allow an unauthorized attacker to access sensitive device operations.

items.title: 66Uptime 远程代码执行漏洞
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经 index.php 传入构造数据执行任意代码，完全控制 66Uptime 监控服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级 66Uptime 及 ping-servers 插件至最新版并限制后台访问
items.repro_note: 向 index.php 构造请求触发代码执行，需自托管实例
items.impact_scope: 自托管监控面板，暴露公网易被扫描
items.description: An issue in AltumCode 66Uptime before v.54.0.0 and 66Uptime ping-servers plugin before v.2.0.0 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the index.php

items.title: MetaMCP mcp-proxy代码执行
items.summary_zh: 可访问代理端点的攻击者请求 /mcp-proxy/server/stdio 触发 STDIO 分支，在服务端执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级 MetaMCP，禁用 inspector 代理或限制其访问来源
items.repro_note: 未授权 GET /mcp-proxy/server/stdio 触发createTransport
items.impact_scope: MCP/AI 开发代理服务，内网资产
items.description: metatool-ai MetaMCP up to and including 2.4.22 is vulnerable to Code Execution in the internal MCP inspector proxy endpoint GET /mcp-proxy/server/stdio (createTransport, STDIO branch, routers/mcp-proxy/server.ts).

items.title: LightLLM RPyC反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 开启 profiling 后，未认证攻击者可连接 RPyC 服务发送恶意 pickle 对象，在推理节点执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 禁用 --enable_profiling，profiler 端口仅限内网并升级
items.repro_note: 启用 --enable_profiling 后未授权连接 RPyC 端口发 pickle
items.impact_scope: LLM推理服务节点，算力主机
items.description: LightLLM through 1.2.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the router profiler service when started with --enable_profiling flag. The service exposes an unauthenticated RPyC server with pickle deserialization enabled, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by sending crafted serialized objects to the profiler command queue.

items.title: Firefox ESR沙箱逃逸UAF
items.summary_zh: 攻击者需先利用渲染进程漏洞，再触发 DOM 内容进程 UAF 逃逸浏览器沙箱，进而访问主机系统。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.repro_note: 需先取得渲染进程漏洞，再触发 DOM UAF 逃逸沙箱
items.impact_scope: 终端浏览器，需结合渲染漏洞
items.description: Sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the DOM: Content Processes component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4, Firefox 157, Firefox ESR 115.42, and Firefox ESR 140.17.

items.title: Firefox ESR沙箱逃逸UAF
items.summary_zh: 攻击者需先利用渲染进程漏洞，再触发 DOM 内容进程 UAF 逃逸浏览器沙箱，进而访问主机系统。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.repro_note: 需先取得渲染进程漏洞，再触发 DOM UAF 逃逸沙箱
items.impact_scope: 终端浏览器，需结合渲染漏洞
items.description: Sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the DOM: Content Processes component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4, Firefox 157, Firefox ESR 115.42, and Firefox ESR 140.17.

items.title: Flowring Agentflow 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: SQL Injection in the /WebAgenda/SMBAjaxAutoComplete.do API endpoint of Flowring Agentflow 4.0 version before 2025/08/08 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the words parameter.

items.title: Flowring Agentflow 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: SQL Injection in the /WebAgenda/SMBAjaxConfigProcess.do API endpoint of Flowring Agentflow 4.0 version before 2025/08/08 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the id parameter.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload 任意文件上传
items.description: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type in the /WebAgenda/download/uploadFile.jsp API endpoint of Flowring Agentflow 4.0 version before 2023/03/24 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary system commands via a malicious file.

items.title: Dbit T-CPE301K 未授权 栈溢出
items.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Dbit T-CPE301K 4G WiFi minirouter allows an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) and a system reboot via a manipulated HTTP POST request directed at the endpoint ‘/js/common/do_cmd.js’ endpoint containing an excessively long parameter, which overwrites the PC and RA registers.

items.title: EVbee DC-80 未授权 CWE-1391
items.description: The firmware for the EVbee DC-80 has a weak hardcoded root password, which allows attackers to login as root using the SSH daemon that is exposed to the network.

items.title: Attacker 权限提升
items.description: Attacker model / Preconditions: a loaded `TXM_MODULE_USER_MODE | TXM_MODULE_MEMORY_PROTECTION` module issuing kernel dispatch calls, on a build with `TX_ENABLE_EVENT_TRACE`. The kernel calls it directly — no validation, no trampoline — from privileged kernel code when the trace buffer wraps.

items.title: SimpleGitOptions.config 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: simple-git, an interface for running git commands in any node.js application, enables applications to execute Git operations from JavaScript. An application that passes attacker-controlled values through SimpleGitOptions.config or inline -c arguments can therefore allow Git to invoke an attacker-selected shell command when git interpret-trailers processes the configured trailer.

items.title: VISUAL 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: Prior to 2.0.1 of the argv-parser package, parseEnv omits VISUAL from GitEnvKeys, so prepareEnv drops the value before vulnerabilityCheck can classify it as allowUnsafeEditor. A consuming application that forwards attacker-influenced environment values can therefore allow Git to invoke an attacker-selected editor during operations such as commit amendment or interactive rebase when no higher-priority editor setting overrides VISUAL and Git's terminal prerequisites are met.

items.title: WatchGuard Fireware OS 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: A code injection vulnerability in WatchGuard Fireware OS's BOVPN Over TLS client configuration handling allows an attacker who controls the remote VPN server to execute arbitrary commands as root on the connecting Firebox.

items.title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to command injection in the certificate export CLI functionality, allowing a privileged authenticated CLI user to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges.

items.title: PHP 任意文件上传
items.description: The TMS file upload endpoint fails to enforce server-side file type restrictions, allowing an attacker to upload and execute arbitrary PHP files on the web server.

items.title: Ziroom ZHOME A0101 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This affects the function set_syslog of the file /api/ZRnetwork/set_syslog. The manipulation of the argument conloglevel/log_size results in command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZRFirmware/set_time_zone. This 注入
items.description: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function set_time_zone of the file /api/ZRFirmware/set_time_zone. This manipulation of the argument hostname/zonename causes command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Such 注入
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /api/ZRnetwork/ping. Such manipulation of the argument url leads to command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Das U-Boot CWE-459
items.description: Das U-Boot with CONFIG_IP_DEFRAG=y parameter fails to clear IP reassembly state after delivering a complete datagram. An attacker who can deliver fragmented IP traffic can execute arbitrary code by sending duplicated last-fragment IP packets. This issue was fixed in commit b1aec609bb5e0d08c25c888c91935287ab4ee5fa in version 2026.07.

items.title: SQL注入
items.description: The "search" parameter in the view audit logs feature within the utilities section is susceptible to a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

items.title: SQL注入
items.description: The "screenID" parameter in the electronic transaction queue viewer feature within the manual transactions section is susceptible to a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

items.title: TMS SQL注入
items.description: The "pattern" parameter used in search function in the home page of the TMS application is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

items.title: SQL注入
items.description: The "reportType" parameter in the product summary report feature within the balancing reports section is susceptible to a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

items.title: SQL注入
items.description: The "supplier_no" parameter used in the business allocation search feature is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL injection.
